```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("C:/Users/Freitag/Documents/GitHub/Phd_Letzkus/analysis/general/data_helpers.R")
library(data.table)


binfree_path <- "I:/Data/aligned/all_good/aligned_raw"
metrics_path <- "I:/Data/aligned/all_good/extra/metrics"
shock_file <- "I:/Data/aligned/extra/Shock_direction.csv"

bomb_path <- "I:/Data/aligned/all_good/extra/bomb"
depth_path <- "I:/Data/aligned/all_good/extra/extremum"

binfree <- read_csv_folder(
  folder_path = binfree_path,
  source_column = "source",
  remove_unnamed_columns = FALSE
) %>%
  add_animal_condition(source_column = "source")



shock <- load_shock_direction(shock_file)



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bomb-cell labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bomb <- read_csv_folder(
  folder_path = bomb_path,
  source_column = "source"
) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = paste(unit_id, source, sep = "_")
  )

bombg <- bomb %>%
  filter(bombcell_label == "good")



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Electrode depth / cortex labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

depth_files <- list.files(
  path = depth_path,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

depths <- map_dfr(depth_files, function(file) {

  source <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  read_csv(
    file,
    col_types = cols(extremum_channel = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = source)
}) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  mutate(
    dist_from_max = max(dist_from_tip_um) - dist_from_tip_um,
    cortex = if_else(dist_from_max < 1000, "cortex", "no"),
    cluster_id = paste(unit_id, source, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cluster_id, dist_from_max, cortex)
```

#add meta

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Trial alignment and readable trial labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sound_state_names <- c(
  "Downsweep",
  "Upsweep",
  "Opto_Upwsweep",
  "Opto_Upsweep",
  "Opto_Downsweep",
  "Laser_Only"
)

trial_starts <- binfree %>%
  filter(state_name %in% sound_state_names) %>%
  group_by(Animal, condition, trial_number) %>%
  summarise(
    minT = min(seconds),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

binfree <- binfree %>%
  left_join(
    trial_starts,
    by = c("Animal", "condition", "trial_number")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_time = seconds - minT
  ) %>%
  recode_trial_type() %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = paste(cluster_id, Animal, condition, sep = "_"),
    trial_number = paste(trial_number, Animal, condition, sep = "_")
  ) 




# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply quality-metric filter
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qm <- load_quality_metrics(
  metrics_path = metrics_path,
  presence_cutoff = 0.8
)  %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = str_replace(
      cluster_id,
      "^((?:[^_]+_){2}[^_]+).*",
      "\\1"
    )
  )



binfree <- binfree %>%
  filter(cluster_id %in% qm$cluster_id) 



```

#realign time

```{r}



setDT(binfree)

# 1. Get unique event times (anchors) PER Animal and condition
# This ensures we don't align Animal 1 to Animal 2's events.
anchor_dt <- binfree[!is.na(minT), .(anchor = unique(minT)), by = .(Animal, condition)]

# Set the key to include the grouping variables + the time variable
setkey(anchor_dt, Animal, condition, anchor)

# 2. Perform the rolling join with grouping constraints
# We add Animal and condition to the 'on' statement.
binfree[, nearest_fixed := anchor_dt[binfree, 
                                     on = .(Animal, condition, anchor = seconds), 
                                     roll = "nearest", 
                                     x.anchor]]

# 3. Compute relative time
binfree[, rel_time := seconds - nearest_fixed]

# 4. Rebuild trial structure
setorder(binfree, Animal, condition, seconds)
binfree[, aligntrial := cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(rel_time) < -1)), by = .(Animal, condition)]
binfree[, aligntrial2 := paste(aligntrial, Animal, condition, sep = "_")]

# 5. Fix trial_type consistency
# For each trial, find the trial_type where rel_time is closest to 0
binfree[, trial_type := trial_type[which.min(abs(rel_time))], by = .(Animal, condition, aligntrial)]

# Now we can safely select and unique-ify later
binfree <- as_tibble(binfree) %>% 
  select(cluster_id, state_name, trial_type, seconds, rel_time, Animal, condition, trial_number = aligntrial2)


binfree %>% distinct(trial_number,trial_type) %>% group_by(trial_number) %>% count(trial_type) %>% filter(n>1)



```

#calculate baseline

```{r}




df_all <- as.data.table(binfree)

baseline_stats_list <- df_all[, {

  df <- .SD[rel_time >= -35 & rel_time < -5]

  # time range (per session)
  curr_range <- range(df$rel_time, na.rm = TRUE)

  bin_width <- 1
  breaks <- seq(curr_range[1], curr_range[2], by = bin_width)
  centers <- breaks[-length(breaks)] + (bin_width / 2)
  num_bins <- length(centers)

  df[, bin_idx := findInterval(rel_time, breaks)]
  df_in <- df[bin_idx > 0 & bin_idx <= num_bins]

  # counts
  counts <- df_in[, .(
    event_count = .N
  ), by = .(cluster_id, trial_number, trial_type, bin_idx)]

  # full grid (session-local!)
  full_grid <- CJ(
    cluster_id   = unique(df$cluster_id),
    trial_number = unique(df$trial_number),
    trial_type   = unique(df$trial_type),
    bin_idx      = seq_len(num_bins)
  )

  res <- counts[full_grid,
                on = .(cluster_id, trial_number, trial_type, bin_idx)]

  res[is.na(event_count), event_count := 0]

  res[, `:=`(
    rel_time = centers[bin_idx],
    rate     = event_count / bin_width
  )]

  baseline_binned <- res[, .(
    rate = mean(rate)
  ), by = .(cluster_id, trial_number, trial_type, bin_idx, rel_time)]

  baseline_binned[, .(
    base_mean = mean(rate),
    base_sd   = sd(rate)
  ), by = cluster_id]

}, by = .(Animal, condition)]

baseline_stats_list <- baseline_stats_list  %>% filter(cluster_id %in% qm$cluster_id)

rm(anchor_dt)
rm(qm)
rm(df_all)
```

```{r}




bin_events_dt_final <- function(dt, bin_width, 
                                groups = c("cluster_id", "trial_number", "trial_type"), 
                                split_by = c("Animal", "condition"),
                                average_by = NULL, # New argument
                                bin_range = NULL, 
                                Zscore = TRUE, 
                                baseline_df = NULL, 
                                smooth_sd = 0) {
  
  df_all <- as.data.table(dt)
  
  # Define the internal processing core
  process_chunk <- function(df, current_baseline = NULL) {
    
    # 1. Standardized Binning Logic
    # We use bin_range to ensure all chunks have identical rel_time bins
   # 1. Standardized Binning Logic
    # Snap the min and max to absolute multiples of bin_width
    # This makes the bin grid completely independent of the exact bin_range values
    min_break <- floor(bin_range[1] / bin_width) * bin_width
    max_break <- ceiling(bin_range[2] / bin_width) * bin_width
    
    breaks <- seq(min_break, max_break, by = bin_width)
    
    # Dynamically calculate the precision needed based on bin_width 
    # e.g., bin_width = 0.05 -> needs ~4 decimal places of safety
    precision <- max(0, ceiling(-log10(bin_width))) + 2
    
    # Round breaks and centers to eliminate floating-point artifacts
    breaks <- round(breaks, precision)
    centers <- round(breaks[-length(breaks)] + (bin_width / 2), precision)
    num_bins <- length(centers)
    
    # Use rightmost.closed = TRUE so spikes at the exact max range aren't dropped
    df[, bin_idx := findInterval(rel_time, breaks, rightmost.closed = TRUE)]
    df_in <- df[bin_idx > 0 & bin_idx <= num_bins]
    
    
    
    # 2. n_trials per Chunk
    # Since all neurons participated in all trials, we calculate this once for the whole chunk
    total_trials_in_chunk <- df[, uniqueN(trial_number)]
    counts <- df_in[, .(event_count = .N), by = .(cluster_id, trial_number, trial_type, bin_idx)]
    # 1. Define the unique entities
    all_clusters <- unique(df$cluster_id)
    # This captures the unique mapping of trial numbers to their types
    # This prevents the "nonsensical combinations" you mentioned
    trial_mapping <- unique(df[, .(trial_number, trial_type)]) 
    
    # 2. Create the "Identity" Grid (Every neuron x Every valid trial)
    # This handles neurons that might have been silent for a whole trial
    identity_grid <- CJ(cluster_id = all_clusters, trial_number = trial_mapping$trial_number)
    
    # 5. Join mapping back (Safe from row explosion now)
    identity_grid <- merge(identity_grid, trial_mapping, by = "trial_number", all.x = TRUE)
    
    # 6. Expand by Time (The Full Rank step)
    # Using CJ here instead of merge(by = NULL) avoids the error you just saw
    full_grid <- CJ(
      cluster_id = all_clusters, 
      trial_number = trial_mapping$trial_number, 
      bin_idx = seq_len(num_bins)
    )
    
    # Re-attach trial_type to the full_grid
    full_grid <- merge(full_grid, trial_mapping, by = "trial_number", all.x = TRUE)
    
    # 7. Join counts onto the full grid
    res <- counts[full_grid, on = .(cluster_id, trial_number, trial_type, bin_idx)]
    res[is.na(event_count), event_count := 0]
    
    # 3. Normalization (Rate calculation)
    # If trial_number is in groups, we are doing trial-by-trial (rate = count / width)
    # If not, we divide by the total trials in this chunk
    if (!"trial_number" %in% groups) {
      res[, rate := event_count / bin_width / total_trials_in_chunk]
    } else {
      res[, rate := event_count / bin_width]
    }
    
    res[, rel_time := centers[bin_idx]]
    
    # 4. Gaussian Smoothing
    if (!is.null(smooth_sd) && smooth_sd > 0) {
      sigma_bins <- smooth_sd / bin_width
      half_width <- ceiling(4 * sigma_bins)
      k_idx <- seq(-half_width, half_width)
      kernel <- exp(-(k_idx^2) / (2 * sigma_bins^2))
      kernel <- kernel / sum(kernel)
      
      # Smooth per unit/trial
      smooth_groups <- intersect(c("cluster_id", "trial_number"), names(res))
      res[, rate := as.numeric(stats::filter(rate, kernel, sides = 2)), by = smooth_groups]
      res[is.na(rate), rate := 0] 
    }
    
    # 5. Z-Score Section
    if (Zscore) {
      if (!is.null(current_baseline)) {
        res <- merge(res, current_baseline, by = "cluster_id", all.x = TRUE)
        res[, z_rate := (rate - base_mean) / (base_sd + 1e-9)]
        cols_to_remove <- intersect(names(res), c("base_mean", "base_sd"))
        res[, (cols_to_remove) := NULL]
      } else {
        res[, z_rate := (rate - mean(rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / (sd(rate, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9), by = cluster_id]
      }
    }
    
    # 6. Averaging Logic
    if (!is.null(average_by)) {
      agg_cols <- "rate"
      if (Zscore) agg_cols <- c("rate", "z_rate")
      avg_groups <- c("rel_time", average_by)
      res <- res[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = avg_groups, .SDcols = agg_cols]
    }
    
    return(res)
  }

  # --- Handle Splitting Logic ---
  if (!is.null(split_by)) {
    chunks <- split(df_all, by = split_by, keep.by = TRUE)
    
    res_list <- lapply(chunks, function(sub_dt) {
      sub_baseline <- NULL
      if (!is.null(baseline_df)) {
        match_criteria <- sub_dt[1, ..split_by]
        sub_baseline <- as.data.table(baseline_df)[match_criteria, on = split_by]
      }
      process_chunk(sub_dt, sub_baseline)
    })
    final_res <- rbindlist(res_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  } else {
    final_res <- process_chunk(df_all, baseline_df)
  }

  if ("bin_idx" %in% names(final_res)) final_res[, bin_idx := NULL]
  return(as_tibble(final_res))
}
```


# responses over trials

```{r}
res2 <- binfree %>% 
  mutate(Opto = ifelse(str_starts(trial_type, 'Opto'), 'opto', 'no')) %>% 
  filter(Opto == "no") %>% 
  mutate(trial_sequence = as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(trial_number, "_.*"))) %>% 
  group_by(Animal, condition,fear) %>% 
  filter(trial_sequence %in% sort(unique(trial_sequence))[1:12]) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  bin_events_dt_final(
    bin_width = 0.1,
    bin_range = c(-0.1,5), # Averages trials, keeps clusters
    baseline_df = baseline_stats_list,
    average_by = NULL)




id_lookup <- res2 %>%
  distinct(cluster_id) %>%
  separate(cluster_id, into = c("trash", "Animal", "condition"), sep = "_", extra = "merge",remove = F) %>% select(!trash)

res2 <- res2 %>% left_join(id_lookup) %>% left_join(shock) %>% mutate(fear = ifelse(direction == stringr::str_remove(trial_type, "^Opto_"),'cs+',"cs-")) %>% left_join(depths) 
 res2 <- res2 %>%  filter(cluster_id %in% bombg$cluster_id)

# in the cs+ condition, it looks like later trials ( lighter colors) have higher responses

res2 %>% filter(between(rel_time,-0.1,5.15)) %>% left_join(shock) %>% mutate(fear = ifelse(direction == stringr::str_remove(trial_type, "^Opto_"),'cs+',"cs-")) %>% 
  mutate(trial_sequence = as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(trial_number, "_.*"))) %>% 
  
  group_by(Animal, condition,fear) %>% 
  mutate(trial_rank = dense_rank(trial_sequence)) %>% 
  filter(trial_rank <= 12) %>% 
  
  group_by(trial_rank, rel_time,fear) %>% 
  summarise(mz = mean(rate), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, mz, group = trial_rank, col = trial_rank)) +
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~fear)


# seeing this per peak ( sound repetion) it seems like cs+ does indeed increase with trials

  group_by(Animal, condition,fear) %>%

  filter(trial_rank <= 12) %>%  group_by(trial_rank, peak,fear) %>%

      labs(title = paste("Animal ID:", animal_id),
           y = "Mean Z-Rate",
           x = "Trial Rank") +

  })

read_csv_folder <- function(folder_path) {
  # 1. List all CSV files in the directory
  files <- list.files(
    path = folder_path, 
    pattern = "\\.csv$", 
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  # Check if folder is empty to avoid errors
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop("No CSV files found in the specified directory.")
  }

  # 2. Read all files into one dataframe
  # The 'id' argument creates a column with the full file path
  df <- read_csv(files, id = "file_origin") %>%
    mutate(
      # 3. Clean the 'file_origin' column
      # basename() removes the path, file_path_sans_ext() removes .csv
      file_origin = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_origin))
    )
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
df_all <- as.data.table(binfree)
# Define your bin width once to ensure consistency
base_bin_width <- 1 
breaks <- seq(-35, -5, by = base_bin_width)
centers <- breaks[-length(breaks)] + (base_bin_width / 2)

# 1. Pre-calculate bin_idx on the full data table to avoid .SD locking
df_all[, bin_idx := findInterval(rel_time, breaks)]

baseline_stats_list <- df_all[rel_time >= -35 & rel_time < -5, {
  
  # 2. Create the "Every Neuron x Every Trial x Every Bin" grid
  # This is the secret sauce for a Z-score that averages to 0
  full_grid <- CJ(
    cluster_id   = unique(cluster_id),
    trial_number = unique(trial_number),
    bin_idx      = seq_along(centers)
  )
  
  # 3. Count spikes per bin (on the already-filtered .SD)
  counts <- .SD[, .(.N), by = .(cluster_id, trial_number, bin_idx)]
  
  # 4. Join and fill zeros
  res <- counts[full_grid, on = .(cluster_id, trial_number, bin_idx)]
  res[is.na(N), N := 0]
  res[, rate := N / base_bin_width]
  
  # 5. Calculate stats across the pooled distribution
  res[, .(
    base_mean = mean(rate),
    base_sd   = sd(rate)
  ), by = cluster_id]

}, by = .(Animal, condition)]

# Clean up
df_all[, bin_idx := NULL]
baseline_stats_list <- baseline_stats_list %>% mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal))



res3 <- binfree  %>% 
  bin_events_dt_final(
    bin_width = 0.1,
    bin_range = c(-1,7), # Averages trials, keeps clusters
    baseline_df = baseline_stats_list,
    average_by = c('cluster_id',"trial_type"))
```

```{r}
# it seems as if the main effect is on the onset peak
# if we exclude the top5 % strongest Units, we get back to pre-conditioning activation levels

excluded_units <- res %>% filter(between(rel_time,0,0.05),fear=="cs+",condition=="recall")  %>%
  group_by(condition, cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(
    peak_rate = max(z_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = peak_rate,
    prop = 0.1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Exclude those units before calculating the mean firing rate
res %>%
  anti_join(
    excluded_units,
    by = c("condition", "cluster_id")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    between(rel_time, -0.05, 0.05),
    fear == "cs+"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mz = mean(z_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(condition,rel_time)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, mz, colour = condition)) +
```

```{r}
tone_onsets <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)

    res %>%
      filter(condition == "recall",

      pivot_wider(names_from = window,
                  values_from = rate) %>%
      mutate(onset_score = onset - tone)
  ) %>%
  summarise(stimlock = mean(onset_score),
            .by = cluster_id)
```

```{r}
E <- res %>% filter(between(rel_time,-1,6)) %>% mutate(rel_time = floor(rel_time/0.1)*0.1) %>% summarise(mz = mean(z_rate),.by = c(condition,rel_time)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(rel_time,mz,col=condition))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~condition) +  ggtitle("100 ms")


A+B+C+D+E+plot_layout(guides = 'collect')
```
